    #!/bin/sh
    # Recreate standalone container "dokploy-traefik": generated by moi from the Docker API.
    # Review before running. Better: move it into a compose file.
    set -e
    docker run -d \
      --name dokploy-traefik \
      --restart always \
      --network dokploy-network \
      -p 443:443 \
      -p 80:80 \
      -v /etc/dokploy/traefik/dynamic:/etc/dokploy/traefik/dynamic \
      -v /etc/dokploy/traefik/traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml \
      -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro \
      -e CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=… \
      --log-opt max-file=3 \
      --log-opt max-size=10m \
      traefik:v3.6.1
    docker network connect homelab dokploy-traefik
